column4: cleat#3245 Phase 3 step 2 piece 4b: all four tests open a *PostgresStore directly via testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) (finalizeLeaseTestStore), which skips on CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES alone regardless of what else is set -- workflow_leases/workflow_payloads are PostgreSQL-only (the issue's own scoping decision, same as pieces 2/3/4a's tests), so these four have no MySQL or MSSQL form to run instead. multi-db/mysql sets CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all four skip here. 4 skips, not a subtest group -- same shape as completion-updates-the-lease-and-payload-rows.tsv's four.
same four tests, same reason: multi-db/mssql sets CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL and not CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES, so all four skip here too -- see the multi-db/mysql line above.
